:::{#exr-bernoulli-hessian-contribution-fraction}
#### Hessian contribution of one binary outcome over a common denominator

In the setting of @exr-bernoulli-hessian-contribution,
write the [Hessian](#def-hessian) contribution $\hess_\iobs(\prob)$
as one term, by finding a common denominator for its two terms
and then writing the denominator with the [precision](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-precision) $\precision = 1 / \paren{\prob(1 - \prob)}$.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-bernoulli-hessian-contribution-fraction}

Starting from @thm-bernoulli-hessian-contribution:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\hess_\iobs(\prob)
&= -\frac{\outvar_\iobs}{\sqf{\prob}} - \frac{1 - \outvar_\iobs}{\sqf{1 - \prob}}
&& \text{(the contribution from the theorem above)}\\
&= -\frac{\outvar_\iobs \sqf{1 - \prob}}{\sqf{\prob} \sqf{1 - \prob}} - \frac{\paren{1 - \outvar_\iobs} \sqf{\prob}}{\sqf{\prob} \sqf{1 - \prob}}
&& \text{(write both terms over the common denominator $\sqf{\prob} \sqf{1 - \prob}$)}\\
&= -\frac{\outvar_\iobs \sqf{1 - \prob} + \paren{1 - \outvar_\iobs} \sqf{\prob}}{\sqf{\prob} \sqf{1 - \prob}}
&& \text{(combine over the common denominator)}\\
&= -\frac{\outvar_\iobs \sqf{1 - \prob} + \paren{1 - \outvar_\iobs} \sqf{\prob}}{\sqf{\prob(1 - \prob)}}
&& \text{($\sqf{a} \sqf{b} = \sqf{ab}$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

The numerator simplifies in the following steps:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\outvar_\iobs \sqf{1 - \prob} + \paren{1 - \outvar_\iobs} \sqf{\prob}
&= \outvar_\iobs \paren{1 - 2 \prob + \sqf{\prob}} + \paren{1 - \outvar_\iobs} \sqf{\prob}
&& \text{(expand $\sqf{1 - \prob}$)}\\
&= \outvar_\iobs - 2 \prob \outvar_\iobs + \outvar_\iobs \sqf{\prob} + \sqf{\prob} - \outvar_\iobs \sqf{\prob}
&& \text{(distribute $\outvar_\iobs$ and $\sqf{\prob}$)}\\
&= \outvar_\iobs - 2 \prob \outvar_\iobs + \sqf{\prob} + \outvar_\iobs \sqf{\prob} - \outvar_\iobs \sqf{\prob}
&& \text{(reorder the terms)}\\
&= \outvar_\iobs - 2 \prob \outvar_\iobs + \sqf{\prob} + 0
&& \text{($\outvar_\iobs \sqf{\prob} - \outvar_\iobs \sqf{\prob} = 0$)}\\
&= \outvar_\iobs - 2 \prob \outvar_\iobs + \sqf{\prob}
&& \text{($a + 0 = a$)}\\
&= \paren{1 - 2 \prob} \outvar_\iobs + \sqf{\prob}
&& \text{(collect the terms in $\outvar_\iobs$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting the numerator back in:

$$
\hess_\iobs(\prob)
= -\frac{\paren{1 - 2 \prob} \outvar_\iobs + \sqf{\prob}}{\sqf{\prob(1 - \prob)}}
\qquad \text{(substitute the numerator)}
$$

The denominator is the square of the reciprocal of the [precision](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-precision):

$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{1}{\sqf{\prob(1 - \prob)}}
&= \sqf{\paren{\frac{1}{\prob(1 - \prob)}}}
&& \text{($\frac{1}{\sqf{a}} = \sqf{\paren{\frac{1}{a}}}$)}\\
&= \sqf{\precision}
&& \text{(definition of $\precision$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting the denominator:

$$
\hess_\iobs(\prob)
= -\sqf{\precision} \paren{\paren{1 - 2 \prob} \outvar_\iobs + \sqf{\prob}}
\qquad \text{(substitute $\sqf{\precision}$)}
$$

:::
